_说明: 界面字对照表（文案w）。键是代码里写死的中文，{0}{1} 是变量；i18n.js 在网页上查表替换。text.json 的内容另在 data/tour/text.en.json。
拖动或滚轮看长卷，点亮着的地点进去: Drag or scroll along the picture scroll. Click a lit place to enter.
第一次进入要准备场景和人物，稍等片刻；之后再来会快很多。: The first visit has to load the scenes and characters, so give it a moment. It is much faster after that.
手机建议连 Wi-Fi。: On a phone, Wi-Fi is best.
这里有实景扫描的房间，第一次进入会久一点，请多等一会儿。: Some rooms here are 3D scans, so the first visit takes longer.
点地面，药郎就走过去；也可以用 WASD，按住 Shift 快走: Click the floor and the Medicine Seller walks there. WASD works too; hold Shift to hurry.
看到「観」点一下，会走过去打开说明卡: See a 観 marker? Click it to walk over and read the card.
拖动转镜头，滚轮拉远拉近: Drag to turn the camera, scroll to zoom.
按 X，药郎会拔出退魔之剑: Press X and the Medicine Seller draws the Exorcism Sword.
P 拍照，F 换滤镜（夜色、雨、褪色），O 换姿势: P takes a photo, F changes the filter (night, rain, faded), O changes the pose.
右上角「音」或按 B 开关声音: The 音 button at top right, or B, toggles sound.
左下角按住拖动就能走，推到底走得快: Hold and drag at bottom left to walk; push all the way to hurry.
右下角的摇杆转镜头，两根手指缩放: The stick at bottom right turns the camera; pinch to zoom.
点「拔剑」，药郎会拔出退魔之剑: Tap Draw and the Medicine Seller draws the Exorcism Sword.
点朱红的「拍照」存图，右上角「滤镜」换夜色、雨、褪色: Tap the red Photo button to save a picture; Filter at top right changes to night, rain or faded.
右上角「音」可以开关声音: The 音 button at top right toggles sound.
